paragraphs.en: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
paragraphs.zh: 分诊：在视频扩散 Transformer 中跳过、略读或细化注意力图块

paragraphs.en: Yeonjae Kim 1 Omin Kwon 1 Seong Hoon Seo 1 Jae W. Lee 1
paragraphs.zh: Yeonjae Kim 1 Omin Kwon 1 Seong Hoon Seo 1 Jae W. Lee 1

paragraphs.en: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage , a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile’s error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32 × \times over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3–3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 对数以万计的视觉词元的注意力计算主导了视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的推理。 现有方法通过稀疏化、低精度或二者结合来降低这一开销，但对所有保留的图块使用单一精度。 我们观察到，近似所引入的输出误差在不同图块之间差异很大。 许多图块可以几乎无损地跳过，另一些图块必须计算但在低精度之外收益甚微，还有少数图块即使在低精度下仍存在显著误差。 我们提出 Triage，一种无需训练的注意力方法，它为每个图块分配三种近似层级之一：通过用其块均值替换来跳过该图块、以 NVFP4 粗略计算该图块，或以 NVFP4 残差修正精细计算该图块。 一个轻量级路由器根据块统计信息预测每个图块在各层级下的误差，仅当预测的误差下降足以抵消额外计算时才将图块提升到更精确的层级，并只用一个价格参数控制这一权衡。 一个融合内核在 RTX Blackwell GPU 的 FP4 张量核心上单次执行全部三种层级。 在 Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo 和 LTX-2.5 上，Triage 相比稠密 FlashAttention 将端到端生成加速最高达 2.32 × \times 倍，并且在五种设置中的每一种都比所有基线更快，同时比 PSNR 最高的基线高出 0.3–3.0 dB 的 PSNR。

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention and low-bit attention are the two main approaches to reducing this cost. Both operate on tiles , each pairing a block of queries with a block of keys. Sparse attention selects the tiles to compute and skips the rest, dropping them or approximating each by its mean key and value Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2026) (Figure 1 a). Low-bit attention instead computes every tile in a low-bit format such as FP8 or NVFP4 Zhang et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2025b) (Figure 1 b). Methods that combine the two Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) skip tiles and compute the kept ones in a low-bit format (Figure 1 c).

paragraphs.en: These approaches give a tile at most two options, skipping it or computing it at a single precision shared by every kept tile. Which approach is most accurate depends on the row , the tiles that one query block attends to (Figure 1 ). A row is sharp when its query block puts almost all of its attention on a few tiles, and diffuse when it spreads its attention over many. At the same compute cost, sparse attention tends to be the most accurate on sharp rows, low-bit attention on diffuse rows, and their combination on rows in between.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法至多给每个图块两种选择：跳过它，或以所有保留图块共享的单一精度来计算它。 哪种方法最准确取决于该行，即查询块所关注的图块（图 1）。 当某行的查询块几乎把全部注意力集中在少数几个图块上时，该行是锐利的；当它把注意力分散到许多图块上时，该行是弥散的。 在相同计算成本下，稀疏注意力在锐利的行上往往最准确，低位注意力在弥散的行上最准确，而两者的组合则介于两者之间的行上最准确。

paragraphs.en: Our key observation is that the output error from skipping a tile or computing it at low precision varies widely across tiles, even within the same row. Because this error differs so much from tile to tile, extra computation should be judged by its marginal gain , the output error it removes per unit of additional compute. Existing approaches, which share one precision across all computed tiles, cannot fully exploit these differences: they spend more compute than some tiles need while leaving substantial error on others that would benefit from additional computation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的关键观察是：跳过某个分块或以低精度计算它所产生的输出误差，在不同分块之间差异很大，甚至在同一行内也是如此。 由于这种误差在不同分块之间差异如此之大，额外的计算应当以其边际收益来衡量，即每单位额外计算所能消除的输出误差。 现有方法对所有被计算的分块共享同一精度，无法充分利用这些差异：它们在某些分块上花费了超出所需的计算量，而在另一些分块上却留下了大量误差，而这些分块本可从额外计算中受益。

paragraphs.en: We present Triage , which assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers, namely skip (block means), skim (NVFP4), and refine (NVFP4 with residual correction) (Figure 1 d). Before each attention call, a router estimates each tile’s output error under each tier from block statistics and upgrades a tile only when its marginal gain is at least a price π \pi . Under our error model, this rule reduces to comparing one score per tile against two thresholds, making the decision inexpensive and leaving π \pi as the single user-controlled parameter for the speed–fidelity trade-off. A periodically rebuilt clustering tree groups similar queries and keys into tiles, keeping the block statistics representative and the cheaper approximations accurate.

paragraphs.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We show that existing approaches leave accuracy unexploited because approximation error varies widely across tiles, even within a row, motivating a per-tile choice by marginal gain (§ 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明，现有方法未能充分利用精度，因为近似误差在不同分块（tile）之间差异很大，甚至在同一行内部也是如此，这促使我们基于边际收益进行逐分块（per-tile）的选择（§ 3）。

paragraphs.en: We propose three approximation tiers with a router that estimates each tile’s error under each tier and trades it against compute, and a clustering tree that groups similar tokens into each tile, lowering the error of skipping and skimming (§ 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出三种近似层级，并配有一个路由器来估计每个图块在各层级下的误差，并将其与计算量进行权衡；同时引入一棵聚类树，将相似的词元分组到同一图块中，从而降低跳过与略读带来的误差（§ 5）。

paragraphs.en: We implement all three tiers in one fused kernel on FP4 tensor cores, representing skipped tiles as virtual tiles of block means and refining selected tiles with NVFP4 residual products (§ 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 FP4 张量核心上用单个融合内核实现了全部三个层级，将被跳过的图块表示为块均值的虚拟图块，并使用 NVFP4 残差乘积对选中的图块进行细化（§ 6）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Triage on four video DiTs in five settings and show that it achieves a better trade-off between speed and fidelity than all evaluated baselines (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五种设置下于四个视频 DiT 上评估了 Triage，结果表明它在速度与保真度之间实现了比所有受评估基线更好的权衡（§ 7）。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) iteratively denoise latent representations, which encode videos compressed spatially and temporally by a 3D VAE. These latents are divided into patches that serve as visual tokens. Recent video DiTs apply 3D full attention, in which every token attends to every other across all frames Yang et al. (2025b) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) . This improves quality but makes the cost of attention quadratic in the total number of visual tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）对潜在表示进行迭代去噪，这些潜在表示由3D VAE对视频在空间和时间上进行压缩编码。 这些潜在表示被划分为图块（patch），作为视觉token。 近期的视频DiT采用3D全注意力机制，即每个token在所有帧之间关注其他所有token Yang et al. (2025b) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) 。 这提升了质量，但使注意力的开销随视觉token总数呈二次方增长。

paragraphs.en: Some methods fine-tune models to use sparse attention Zhang et al. (2025e) ; Zhang et al. (2026c) ; Zhang et al. (2026b) , but the additional training cost for each model motivates our focus on training-free methods. Recent training-free methods use three techniques. First, they select tiles dynamically for each input Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2026) , since static masks such as the sliding windows of STA Zhang et al. (2025f) cannot adapt to attention patterns that vary across prompts, layers, and denoising steps. To avoid computing all attention scores, these methods estimate tile masses using block averages of queries and keys. Second, token clustering groups similar tokens into blocks to improve the accuracy of these estimates Yang et al. (2025a) ; Zhou et al. (2026) , a reordering that 3D full attention permits. Applying k k -means to each input adapts the grouping to its tokens, unlike fixed arrangements such as 3D tiling or a Hilbert curve Zhang et al. (2025f) ; Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) . Third, mean-based approximations represent skipped tiles by their block means rather than discarding their contributions entirely Li et al. (2026) ; Zhou et al. (2026) .

paragraphs.en: Low-bit attention reduces the cost of each computed tile by quantizing queries, keys, values, and probabilities for low-precision tensor-core operations. NVFP4 represents each value in the 4-bit E2M1 format. Each group of 16 consecutive values shares an E4M3 scale, and each tensor has an additional FP32 scale. On Blackwell GPUs, the FP4 tensor cores run 4 × \times as fast as BF16 ones with FP32 accumulation on the RTX PRO 6000, and 8 × \times as fast on the RTX 5090.
paragraphs.zh: 低位注意力通过将查询、键、值和概率量化为低精度以在张量核心上运算，从而降低每个计算分片的成本。 NVFP4 以 4 位 E2M1 格式表示每个值。 每组 16 个连续值共享一个 E4M3 缩放因子，且每个张量还有一个额外的 FP32 缩放因子。 在 Blackwell GPU 上，FP4 张量核心在 RTX PRO 6000 上以 FP32 累加运行时速度是 BF16 的 4 × \times 倍，在 RTX 5090 上是 8 × \times 倍。

paragraphs.en: Existing sparse, low-bit, and combined attention methods typically compute all retained tiles at a single precision. We analyze how approximation error varies, first across rows and then among tiles within a row, to identify opportunities for choosing sparsity and precision per tile.

paragraphs.en: We capture queries, keys, and values from dense runs of Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and HunyuanVideo, using four prompts, four denoising steps, and 10 and 15 layers, respectively (160 and 240 attention calls). We measure the relative L2 error of each row’s output against dense attention. We compare three allocations at 25% of the modeled cost of dense BF16 attention, assuming for simplicity that the cost of an operation scales with its bit width, so that 8-bit and 4-bit operations cost half and a quarter as much as BF16 ones. Sparse attention (S) computes the heaviest 25% of each row’s tiles in BF16. Combined attention (S+L) computes the heaviest 50% using the INT8 query–key and FP8 probability–value products of SageAttention2 Zhang et al. (2025a) . Low-bit attention (L) computes all tiles in NVFP4 using SageAttention3 Zhang et al. (2025b) . S and S+L select tiles by exact attention mass from dense attention and drop the rest, isolating allocation effects from mass-estimation error.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 和 HunyuanVideo 的稠密运行中捕获查询、键和值，使用四个提示词、四个去噪步骤，以及分别为 10 层和 15 层（160 次和 240 次注意力调用）。 我们测量每一行输出相对于稠密注意力的 L2 相对误差。 我们在稠密 BF16 注意力建模成本的 25% 下比较三种分配方式，为简化起见，假设操作的成本与其位宽成比例，即 8 位和 4 位操作的成本分别为 BF16 操作的一半和四分之一。 稀疏注意力（S）以 BF16 计算每行中最重的 25% 的瓦片。 组合注意力（S+L）使用 SageAttention2 Zhang et al. sents.en: We compare three allocations at 25% of the modeled cost of dense BF16 attention, assuming for simplicity that the cost of an operation scales with its bit width, so that 8-bit and 4-bit operations cost half and a quarter as much as BF16 ones.

sents.zh: 组合注意力（S+L）使用 SageAttention2 Zhang et al. (2025a) 的 INT8 查询–键乘积和 FP8 概率–值乘积计算最重的 50%。

sents.zh: 低位注意力（L）使用 SageAttention3 Zhang et al. (2025b) 以 NVFP4 计算所有瓦片。

sents.zh: 在固定计算成本下，S、S+L 和 L 三者中哪一个能达到最低误差，取决于该行的注意力分布。

paragraphs.en: S is most accurate on sharp rows, S+L on intermediate rows, and L on diffuse rows. These allocations trade the error from omitting tiles against the error from computing retained tiles at lower precision. To explain why the balance between these errors changes with the row’s attention distribution, we examine how approximating an individual tile changes the row’s output.
paragraphs.zh: S 在尖锐行上最准确，S+L 在中间行上最准确，L 在弥散行上最准确。 这些分配在省略瓦片带来的误差与以较低精度计算保留瓦片带来的误差之间进行权衡。 为解释这两种误差之间的平衡为何随行的注意力分布而变化，我们考察对单个瓦片做近似会如何改变该行的输出。

The tile is either replaced by its block-mean key and value or computed in NVFP4. Figure 3 b shows that both errors grow roughly in proportion to tile mass in each model, with NVFP4 at about a fifth to a quarter of the block-mean error.

paragraphs.en: When one tile holds almost all a row’s mass, skipping the rest can introduce little error, while NVFP4 rounding on that tile can remain large. In diffuse rows, skipping loses more mass, favoring more tiles at lower precision. This helps explain the different winners in Figure 3 a.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个分块几乎包含一整行的全部质量时，跳过其余部分只会引入很小的误差，而该分块上的 NVFP4 舍入误差可能仍然很大。 在质量分散的行中，跳机会损失更多质量，因此更倾向于在较低精度下保留更多分块。 这有助于解释图 3a 中不同优胜方案出现的原因。

paragraphs.en: Within a row, increasing precision costs about the same across all equal-sized tiles, but can remove more output error from heavy tiles, those with large attention mass. The mass–error relationship therefore motivates choosing precision per tile by its marginal gain, the output error removed per unit of additional compute.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一行内，提高精度在所有等大小的瓦片上的成本大致相同，但对于“重”瓦片（即注意力质量较大的瓦片）能够移除更多的输出误差。 因此，这种质量与误差的关系启发我们根据边际收益来为每个瓦片选择精度，即每单位额外计算量所移除的输出误差。

Using NVFP4 for all kept tiles leaves error on the heavy ones, while raising precision for all also increases the cost of keeping the moderate tiles.
paragraphs.zh: 一行中可能包含少量 NVFP4 误差较大的重度分块，以及许多中等分块，它们合在一起的权重质量太大，难以在误差很小的情况下跳过。 对所有保留的分块使用 NVFP4 会在重度分块上留下误差，而全部提升精度又会增加保留中等分块的成本。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates this trade-off. S leaves error on skipped tiles (a), and L leaves rounding error on heavy tiles (b). S+L reduces rounding error on every kept tile but must skip more tiles at the same compute (c). Triage instead matches the computation of each tile to its mass (d), reducing the summed modeled error at equal compute.

paragraphs.en: Triage chooses one of three tiers for each tile. Skip replaces a light tile with the means of its keys and values, skim computes a moderate tile in NVFP4, and refine computes a heavy tile at higher precision. Making this choice by marginal gain sets two goals. The first is to predict the error of each tier with low overhead, without computing the attention scores. Exact masses require the scores that skipping avoids, and the tokens within a tile vary, so cheap summaries such as block means can miss both a tile’s mass and its approximation error. The second is to run the chosen tiers without losing the speed of low-bit computation. Running the tiers in separate kernels requires merging their outputs, and higher precision usually comes from BF16, which runs at a fraction of the FP4 throughput. Figure 5 shows how the two stages of Triage meet these goals.
paragraphs.zh: 分流（Triage）为每个瓦片（tile）选择三个层级之一。 跳过（skip）用其键和值的均值替换轻量瓦片，略读（skim）以 NVFP4 计算中等瓦片，而精算（refine）以更高精度计算繁重瓦片。 通过边际收益做出这一选择需要达成两个目标。 第一是以低开销预测每个层级的误差，且不计算注意力分数。 精确的质量需要跳过所避免的分数，且瓦片内的词元各不相同，因此块均值等廉价摘要可能同时错失瓦片的质量及其近似误差。 第二是在不损失低位计算速度的情况下运行所选层级。 在单独的内核中运行各层级需要合并它们的输出，而更高精度通常来自 BF16，其吞吐量仅为 FP4 的一小部分。 图 5 展示了分流的两个阶段如何实现这些目标。

paragraphs.en: Planning (§ 5 ) first groups similar queries and keys into fixed-size blocks with a clustering tree that repeatedly splits tokens along their principal direction, reducing the variation within each tile and thus the approximation error. It then collects block statistics, including means, variances, and key–value covariances, to estimate tile mass and approximation error without computing all attention scores. A router uses these estimates to choose the tier of each tile. Statistics collection and routing are fused with smoothing and quantization, keeping the planning overhead small. Planning outputs a tier map together with the block means and quantized operands that execution needs.
paragraphs.zh: 规划（§ 5）首先通过一棵聚类树将相似的查询和键分组为固定大小的块，该聚类树沿着主方向反复切分标记（token），从而降低每个分块内部的变异，进而降低近似误差。 随后，它收集块的统计信息，包括均值、方差以及键–值协方差，以便在不计算全部注意力分数的情况下估计分块的质量和近似误差。 路由器利用这些估计值来选择每个分块的层级。 统计信息收集与路由被融合了平滑和量化处理，使规划开销保持在很小的水平。 规划输出一个层级映射表，以及执行所需的块均值和量化后的操作数。

Skipped tiles contribute through their cluster means, which the kernel appends to the keys as virtual tiles, and skimmed tiles use NVFP4 products. Refined tiles add NVFP4 products of the quantization residuals, which nearly match the accuracy of BF16.

paragraphs.en: Triage clusters similar queries and keys to improve both routing estimates and approximate computation. Grouping dissimilar tokens makes block means less representative and can increase the errors from mean replacement and shared quantization scales. Fixed token orders do not adapt to the input, while standard k k -means produces clusters of varying sizes, which the kernel’s fixed-size tiles must either pad or split. Triage therefore uses a divisive clustering tree that groups similar tokens while controlling block size.
paragraphs.zh: Triage 将相似的查询和键聚成簇，以同时改进路由估计和近似计算。 将不相似的 token 分到一组会使块均值失去代表性，并可能增大均值替换和共享量化尺度带来的误差。 固定的 token 排序无法适应输入，而标准的 k k-means 会产生大小不一的簇，核函数的固定大小分块要么需要填充、要么需要拆分。 因此，Triage 采用一种分裂式聚类树，在控制块大小的同时对相似 token 进行分组。

sents.en: Triage clusters similar queries and keys to improve both routing estimates and approximate computation.
sents.zh: Triage 将相似的查询和键聚成簇，以同时改进路由估计和近似计算。

sents.en: Grouping dissimilar tokens makes block means less representative and can increase the errors from mean replacement and shared quantization scales.
sents.zh: 将不相似的 token 分到一组会使块均值失去代表性，并可能增大均值替换和共享量化尺度带来的误差。

sents.en: Fixed token orders do not adapt to the input, while standard k k -means produces clusters of varying sizes, which the kernel’s fixed-size tiles must either pad or split.
sents.zh: 固定的 token 排序无法适应输入，而标准的 k k-means 会产生大小不一的簇，核函数的固定大小分块要么需要填充、要么需要拆分。

sents.en: Triage therefore uses a divisive clustering tree that groups similar tokens while controlling block size.
sents.zh: 因此，Triage 采用一种分裂式聚类树，在控制块大小的同时对相似 token 进行分组。

paragraphs.en: Triage builds separate query and key trees for each head using principal direction divisive partitioning (PDDP) Boley (1998) . Each node represents a group of tokens, and the root contains all queries or all keys of a head. At each node, Triage estimates the principal direction and sorts the tokens by their projections onto it. It then splits the sorted tokens near the midpoint, at a multiple of the target block size. Splitting continues until each leaf holds one block, and only the final block may be partially filled. The trees are rebuilt every five sparse steps. Appendix A gives the full algorithm, including dimensionality reduction and principal-direction estimation.
paragraphs.zh: Triage 使用主方向分裂划分法（PDDP）Boley (1998) 为每个头分别构建查询树和键树。 每个节点表示一组 token，根节点包含某个头的全部查询或全部键。 在每个节点上，Triage 估计主方向，并按 token 在该方向上的投影对其进行排序。 然后在接近中点、且为目标块大小整数倍的位置，对排序后的 token 进行切分。 切分持续进行，直到每个叶子节点只持有一个块，且只有最后一个块可能是部分填充的。 这些树每五个稀疏步骤重建一次。 附录 A 给出了完整的算法，包括降维和主方向估计。

We fix both for every model and setting, so π \pi is the only parameter that we tune. paragraphs.en: A refined tile needs higher accuracy than a skimmed one, which could come from BF16 in two ways. A second BF16 kernel over the refined tiles would need an extra launch, load Q Q and write the output a second time, and add a merge pass. BF16 products inside the same kernel would avoid these costs, but BF16 tensor cores are several times slower than the FP4 ones (§ 2.3 ). Triage instead refines tiles on the FP4 tensor cores, where three FP4 products still take less time than one BF16 product at peak rates.

paragraphs.en: We remove the refine tier and the clustering tree from Triage (Figure 9 c,d) and then each factor of the router score ( Table 2 ).

paragraphs.en: Without the refine tier, the error of Triage never falls below 9.6% and 6.9%. Refining the tiles that the router selects removes this floor, down to 2.0% and 1.3%, and at equal error makes Triage 1.5 × \times and 1.9 × \times faster, because accurate kept tiles let the router skip more of the others.
paragraphs.zh: 若没有精炼层（refine tier），Triage 的误差始终不会低于 9.6% 和 6.9%。 对路由器选出的图块进行精炼可消除这一下限，将误差降至 2.0% 和 1.3%，并且在相同误差下使 Triage 提速 1.5 × \times 和 1.9 × \times 倍，因为被保留的图块越精确，路由器就能跳过越多其他图块。

sents.en: Refining the tiles that the router selects removes this floor, down to 2.0% and 1.3%, and at equal error makes Triage 1.5 × \times and 1.9 × \times faster, because accurate kept tiles let the router skip more of the others.

paragraphs.en: Without the tree, tiles mix dissimilar tokens, so their means represent them poorly and Triage must compute more tiles to reach the same error. Removing the tree from the variant without refinement raises its lowest error from 9.6% to 12.9% on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and from 6.9% to 7.3% on HunyuanVideo, and on HunyuanVideo makes it 1.2–1.3 × \times slower at equal error (Figure 9 c,d).
paragraphs.zh: 若没有树结构，瓦片会混合不相似的词元，因此其均值对它们的代表性较差，Triage 必须计算更多瓦片才能达到相同的误差。 在不带精炼的变体中去掉树结构，会使最低误差在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 上从 9.6% 升至 12.9%，在 HunyuanVideo 上从 6.9% 升至 7.3%，并且在 HunyuanVideo 上使其在相同误差下慢 1.2–1.3 × \times（图 9 c,d）。

paragraphs.en: Triage shows that sparse and low-bit attention need not be competing choices: deciding for each tile whether to skip, skim, or refine it lets attention spend precision according to the estimated error reduction. A lightweight router makes this choice from block statistics, and one fused kernel runs all three tiers on the FP4 tensor cores. Across three families of video DiTs, Triage achieves a better trade-off between speed and fidelity than existing methods, without retraining or modifying the model. As attention takes a growing share of generation with longer and higher-resolution videos, choosing precision tile by tile becomes increasingly important for making video generation practical.
paragraphs.zh: Triage（分诊）表明，稀疏注意力与低位宽注意力并非必须二选一的竞争关系：为每个分块决定是跳过、略读还是精读，可以让注意力根据估计的误差降低量来分配精度。 一个轻量级路由器根据块级统计信息做出这一选择，并且一个融合内核在 FP4 张量核心上运行全部三个层级。 在三个视频 DiT 家族上，Triage 在速度与保真度之间实现了比现有方法更好的权衡，且无需重新训练或修改模型。 随着视频更长、分辨率更高，注意力在生成中所占的份额不断增长，逐分块地选择精度对于让视频生成变得实用变得越来越重要。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 builds the tile-aligned PDDP tree Boley (1998) of § 5.1 for the tokens of one head. Triage runs it separately for the queries ( b = 128 b=128 ) and the keys ( b = 64 b=64 ), and processes all heads of a layer together. Lines 1–3 project the tokens once onto their top r r principal components. We use r = 32 r=32 and T = 8 T=8 power iterations. Each node of the tree is a half-open range [ s , e ) [s,e) of positions in the order σ \sigma , holding the tokens σ ⁡ [ s ] , … , σ ⁡ [ e − 1 ] \sigma[s],\dots,\sigma[e-1] . Each iteration of the loop then splits every node that spans more than one block, all nodes of a level at once: it finds the node’s top principal direction in the r r -dimensional subspace, sorts the node’s tokens along it, and cuts after ⌊ m / 2 ⌋ \lfloor m/2\rfloor blocks, so both children again span whole blocks. The loop runs ⌈ log 2 ⁡ ( N / b ) ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}(N/b)\rceil times. Each iteration reads Z Z once to form the per-node r × r r\times r covariances in O ⁡ ( N ​ r 2 ) O(Nr^{2}) , runs T T power iterations on them, and performs one segmented sort in O ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) O(N\log N) , so with r r , T T , and b b fixed the loop costs O ⁡ ( ( N ​ r 2 + N ​ log ⁡ N ) ​ log ⁡ ( N / b ) ) O\big((Nr^{2}+N\log N)\log(N/b)\big) in total, in addition to the initial projection. paragraphs.en: Attention takes 47%, 84%, 71%, and 85% of a dense denoising step on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, HunyuanVideo 540p, Wan2.2-T2V-A14B, and HunyuanVideo 720p, and 80% of a dense stage-2 step on LTX-2.5. paragraphs.en: Figure 10 shows how the tiers follow the entropy of a row. Every quintile contains all three tiers: on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, the router skips 61–84% of the tiles and refines 3–12% in every quintile. What changes with entropy is where the mass lies. In sharp rows (Q1), the refined tiles hold 95% of the mass on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and 79% on HunyuanVideo, as § 3.2 suggests. In diffuse rows (Q5), the router refines at most 3% of the tiles and splits the mass between skimmed tiles and many skipped tiles, each of which holds little mass.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10 展示了各层级如何跟随一行的熵变化。 每个五分位都包含全部三个层级：在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 上，路由器在每个五分位中跳过 61–84% 的图块，并对 3–12% 进行精炼。 随熵变化的是质量分布的位置。 在清晰行（Q1）中，被精炼的图块在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 上持有 95% 的质量，在 HunyuanVideo 上持有 79%，这与 § 3.2 的预测一致。 在弥散行（Q5）中，路由器最多精炼 3% 的图块，并将质量分配在略读图块和许多被跳过的图块之间，后者每个仅持有很少的质量。
